spec.prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of an OPEN pharmaceutical injection-pen carry kit. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY and reproduce the WHOLE scene faithfully — change ONLY the small text printed on the white pen's label. SCENE: a navy rigid carry case lying horizontal with its hinged lid open and standing up at the back; inside, a sleek WHITE cartridge injection pen rests in the foreground along the case, and three dark-green glass cartridge vials stand upright in a moulded tray slot behind it; everything sits on a light grey stone/marble surface. CAMERA: slight top-down three-quarter angle over the open case, the kit filling ~90% of frame width. LIGHTING: soft key from top-left, gentle realistic shadows on the stone. ON THE WHITE PEN, a small neat label in navy #1b2846, left-aligned: the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark with cyan accent, the product name '{product_name}' (Montserrat SemiBold, the largest line on the small label), {dose_clause}and a small muted-grey 'SC · Cartridge Pen'. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: keep the pen label small, crisp and legible exactly as in the reference; do not enlarge it or add text elsewhere; if no dose is specified do NOT invent one. There is NO schedule badge anywhere. Do NOT print 'Novecy' or any third-party/compounder branding. Clean premium clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, high detail, sRGB. 1126x1234.
